items.name: Egyptian Lentil Soup
items.desc: Slow-cooked red lentils with cumin, finished with caramelized onions and crispy sourdough croutons in herb oil.

items.name: Classic Fattoush
items.desc: Heirloom tomatoes, cucumber, purslane, and radish with pomegranate molasses and sumac vinaigrette, topped with crispy pita chips.

items.name: Hawawshi-Stuffed Mushrooms
items.desc: Jumbo portobello mushrooms filled with spiced minced beef in the style of Hawawshi, served with harissa cream and herb oil.

items.name: Baba Ganoush & Pita
items.preview: Smoked paprika oil, freshly baked pita
items.desc: Smoked eggplant whipped with tahini and garlic, finished with smoked paprika oil and served with freshly baked pita.

items.name: Braised Lamb Kofta
items.desc: Slow-braised spiced lamb kofta in a rich herb-tomato broth, served over orzo with toasted pine nuts and fresh herbs.

items.name: Pan-Seared Sea Bass
items.desc: Crispy-skinned sea bass with a dukkah crust, served over tahini beurre blanc with wilted seasonal greens and lemon zest.

items.name: Slow-Cooked Chicken
items.desc: Tender chicken thigh braised in a Molokhia-inspired sauce, served as a creamy risotto with caramelized garlic confit.

items.name: Stuffed Vine Leaves (Warak Dawali)
items.desc: Hand-rolled vine leaves stuffed with spiced rice, minced beef, and herbs, slow-cooked in a light tomato broth. Served with labna.

items.name: Freekeh Pilaf
items.desc: Roasted green wheat cooked in a rich stock with caramelized onions, golden raisins, and fresh herbs.

items.name: Roasted Root Vegetables
items.desc: Seasonal roots roasted until caramelized, finished with chermoula, toasted pine nuts, and fresh pomegranate.

items.name: Saffron Rice
items.desc: Fragrant long-grain rice cooked in saffron stock with dried apricots, currants, and crispy shallots.

items.name: Om Ali Brûlée
items.desc: Our reimagining of the classic Egyptian bread pudding — baked with flaky pastry, cream, and nuts, with a caramelized brûlée top and rosewater cream.

items.name: Date & Tahini Tart
items.desc: Buttery tart shell filled with Medjool date frangipane and tahini caramel, finished with cardamom whipped cream and fleur de sel.

items.name: Basbousa Parfait
items.desc: Layers of semolina cake soaked in orange blossom syrup, clotted cream, crushed pistachios, and candied citrus.
